summary: Massively parallel SIMD computing on NVIDIA GPU hardware: kernels, thread blocks, shared memory, and AI tensor acceleration.

rows.means: declares a GPU kernel function called from the CPU (host)
rows.consequence: Executes on the GPU device asynchronously across thousands of parallel threads. Must return void.

rows.means: GPU function callable only from other GPU kernels or functions
rows.consequence: Compiled directly into GPU PTX assembly; executed by individual threads on streaming multiprocessors.

rows.means: standard function that executes on the CPU host
rows.consequence: Functions can be declared __host__ __device__ to compile for both CPU and GPU execution.
gridDim specifies the number of thread blocks; blockDim specifies the number of threads per block (up to 1024).

rows.means: built-in 3D coordinates of current thread and block
rows.consequence: int idx = blockIdx.x * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x computes the unique global 1D thread index for array processing.

rows.means: dimensions of the thread block / dimensions of the grid
rows.consequence: Allows writing kernels that map directly to 1D vectors, 2D image matrices, or 3D volumetric tensor data.

rows.means: allocates raw memory on the GPU's high-bandwidth VRAM
rows.consequence: The CPU cannot directly dereference d_ptr; data must be transferred using cudaMemcpy.

rows.means: copies data over the PCIe bus from CPU RAM to GPU VRAM
rows.consequence: Transferring data across PCIe is often the main performance bottleneck in GPU computing; minimize transfers.

rows.means: transfers computed results from GPU VRAM back to CPU RAM
rows.consequence: Synchronizes execution: the CPU blocks until the memory transfer completes.

rows.means: frees allocated VRAM memory on the GPU device
rows.consequence: Must be called for every cudaMalloc to prevent running out of GPU memory (CUDA Out of Memory).

rows.means: allocates ultra-fast on-chip SRAM shared by threads in a block
rows.consequence: Shared memory has orders of magnitude lower latency and higher bandwidth than global VRAM; used for tile caching in matrix multiplication.

rows.means: barrier synchronization for all threads in the same block
rows.consequence: Guarantees that all threads in the block reach this point before any thread continues, preventing race conditions on shared memory.

rows.means: CPU host halts and waits for all launched GPU kernels to finish
rows.consequence: Kernel launches (<<<...>>>) are asynchronous. cudaDeviceSynchronize() blocks until all GPU work is complete.

rows.means: hardware execution unit executing the same instruction in lockstep
rows.consequence: If threads in a warp take different branches (warp divergence), both branches are executed serially, degrading performance.

rows.means: hardware-level atomic addition preventing race conditions
rows.consequence: Guarantees correct results when multiple threads update the same global or shared memory address simultaneously.
